'''"Red Eagle"''' is a featured NPC in the [[Somnium Labyrinth]] during the quest of [[Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno]]. During the event, he takes form as an illusia in [[Yinlin]]'s [[Somnoire]]. During the quest, he turns out was a "mole"<ref>Someone who pretends to be a loyal member of an organization while secretly working for another group.</ref>  in the Public Security Bureau.
